# STMicroelectronics invests more than 100 million euros to strengthen the production capacities of its Rousset site


Nov 20, 2026 Rousset, France

STMicroelectronics (NYSE: STM), a global semiconductor leader serving customers across the spectrum of electronics applications, announces an investment of more than 100 million euros at its Rousset site in the Bouches-du-Rhône, France. Launched in 2025 as part of the industrial footprint reshaping strategy announced by the company, this investment program will continue through 2027. It will increase the site’s production capabilities with the expansion of the clean room by 1,000 m² and the rollout of a program to increase automation and optimization of production flows, reinforcing Rousset’s position as an advanced manufacturing site in Europe.


*“Our Rousset manufacturing site plays an essential role for the automotive, industrial, space and consumer electronics markets. The investments underway reinforce the fab’s strategic importance in our industry where productivity, quality, supply continuity and cost control are critical. This program exemplifies ST’s approach of investing in European manufacturing by combining AI, automation and developing our employees’ skills to create value for our customers and opportunities for our employees,”* said Thomas Morgenstern, Executive Vice President, Manufacturing, STMicroelectronics.


*“This investment of more than 100 million euros marks a new stage in the development of ST’s Rousset site. The expansion of our clean room will strengthen our production capabilities and support the ramp-up of our activities with an even more high-performing industrial tool. These changes open new prospects for ST Rousset and for our teams, by creating opportunities for skills development and career progression. They also help strengthen our longstanding roots in the local ecosystem,”* added Philippe Marc, site director of STMicroelectronics Rousset.


As a strategic European industrial and technology hub, ST Rousset brings together design, research and development, 200 mm silicon wafer manufacturing, electrical testing, and sales and marketing. The site employs around 3,000 people and operates 24/7. It produces components intended for key applications found in smartphones, datacenters, consumer electronics, cars, bank cards, mobile payment, passports and satellite communications.


**Two initiatives to support the site’s ramp-up**


To support growing customer demand for semiconductors, the site is investing in its 200 mm clean room. This development is not based solely on new equipment. It also focuses on production flows, automation and the integration of key stages through two initiatives:


• The expansion of the clean room, with 1,000 m² of additional space added to the existing 10,000 m², to install new machines and upgrade equipment, increasing productivity and volumes.


• The strengthening of automation and optimization of flows, with the extension of the overhead automated wafer lot transport system (Automated Material Handling System – AMHS): 700 meters of rails are being added to the existing 900 meters, allowing lots to travel up to 30 km per day. Combined with smarter production control and connected process monitoring, this development improves the safety, predictability, efficiency and responsiveness of the site’s production activities.


**An investment with a strong human dimension**


Beyond the industrial investment, this development has a strong human dimension. It has already led to the creation of 100 new positions, filled through external recruitment or internal mobility. Around forty engineer and technician positions remain to be filled. At the same time, ST is supporting its employees in developing new skills so they can move into higher value-added roles in automation, digitalization, process control, equipment supervision, and more.


Finally, around 60 partner companies are contributing to this development, illustrating ST’s structuring role in the economic and industrial ecosystem of the Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur region.


**ST in France: a long-term commitment**


The investment at the Rousset site is part of the continued growth of STMicroelectronics’ activities in France, where the company has been established for more than 50 years, and underscores its strategic role within the industrial and R&D ecosystems.


• Significant investments: between 2018 and 2026, ST will have invested 12.1 billion euros (13.5 billion US dollars) in capital expenditures and R&D spending in France.


• A leading employer: ST has 12 sites in France, including 4 manufacturing plants, and employs 12,500 people, including more than 3,000 researchers and engineers dedicated to R&D.


• Broad technological reach: by working with nearly 150 industrial and scientific partners, including 42% SMEs, ST actively contributes to strengthening value chains, innovation, and the consolidation of French and European technological sovereignty.


**About STMicroelectronics Rousset**
Established in 1979, the ST Rousset site in Bouches-du-Rhône, France is a fully integrated 54-hectare site bringing together design, research and development, manufacturing, electrical testing, sales and marketing. It employs around 3,000 people, including 1,500 engineers and managers. Its products and technologies are at the heart of applications such as mobile terminals, industrial control, artificial intelligence infrastructure and data centers, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, bank cards, passports, satellite communications and mobile payment.


ST Rousset also plays a key role in the regional ecosystem. The site is one of the founding members and major stakeholders of I-NOVMICRO, the microelectronics industry in the Sud Region, within the Campus des Métiers et des Qualifications Industrie du Futur. It contributes to the development of skills and jobs in microelectronics in collaboration with academic and industrial stakeholders in the area. The site is notably involved in partnerships with several university laboratories, the Georges Charpak Microelectronics Center, and local initiatives dedicated to innovation, training and the region’s attractiveness. It is also involved in collaborative programs such as AKTANTIS, CIM PACA, Espace Mapp and Entreprendre Pour Apprendre, and has a Fab lab open to start-ups and engineering schools.


**About STMicroelectronics**
At ST, we are 49,000 creators and makers of semiconductor technologies mastering the semiconductor supply chain with state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities. An integrated device manufacturer, we work with more than 200,000 customers and thousands of partners to design and build products, solutions, and ecosystems that address their challenges and opportunities, and the need to support a more sustainable world. Our technologies enable smarter mobility, more efficient power and energy management, and the wide-scale deployment of cloud-connected autonomous things. We are on track to be carbon neutral in all direct and indirect emissions (scopes 1 and 2), product transportation, business travel, and employee commuting emissions (our scope 3 focus), and to achieve our 100% renewable electricity sourcing goal by the end of 2027.
